lines.zh: 四只短腿一起迈，像数拍子。
lines.en: Four short legs step together, counting time.

lines.zh: 低头的草，比抬头的天重要。
lines.en: The grass at my feet matters more than the sky.

lines.zh: 我脖子一伸一缩，边走边找。
lines.en: My neck stretches and retracts as I walk and search.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的平原，也是这种泥。
lines.en: Triassic plains had mud like this too.

lines.zh: 阿根廷的风，我记得一点点。
lines.en: I remember a little of Argentinian wind.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草，第二天又长回来。
lines.en: The grass I tread returns the next day.

lines.zh: 同伴在前头，我跟着它的尾巴。
lines.en: My kin leads; I follow its tail.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，因为跑不快。
lines.en: I walk steadily, because I cannot run.

lines.zh: 尾巴左右摆，帮我找平衡。
lines.en: My tail sways side to side to balance me.
Tender grass here; I take two more steps.

lines.zh: 我抬起前脚，够一棵矮树芽。
lines.en: I rear up to reach a low shoot.
My shadow is short; noon is here.

lines.zh: 草丛里藏着虫声，我不理。
lines.en: Insects chirp in the grass; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我整个身子都很轻，除了肚子。
lines.en: All of me is light, except my belly.

lines.zh: 这株长得太硬，我绕过去。
lines.en: This plant is tough; I go around.
Walk a while, stop a while, eat all the way.

lines.zh: 我的脚印比你的手掌小。
lines.en: My footprints are smaller than your palm.
There are three of my kin; I can count them.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼，很久才咽下去。
lines.en: I chew slowly and swallow after a long while.
The sun is right; I narrow my eyes.
This leaf tastes a little bitter.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一丛矮树。
lines.en: I stand still as a low shrub.

lines.zh: 小虫子落在我鼻子上，飞走了。
lines.en: A bug lands on my snout and flies off.

lines.zh: 我把头歪过去，看一只蝴蝶。
lines.en: I tilt my head at a butterfly.
My neck itches; I rub it on the grass.
I make a very small burp.
Grass moves in the wind; I look up.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的我，也很爱晒太阳。
lines.en: Even in the Triassic I loved the sun.

lines.zh: 同伴在远处，发出低低的声音。
lines.en: My kin is far off, making a low sound.
Chewing, I nearly doze off.

lines.zh: 我的比例像老鼠，个头不像。
lines.en: My proportions are mouse-like; my size is not.

lines.zh: 这丛草已经被我啃平了。
lines.en: I have cropped this clump flat.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，久久不放下。
lines.en: I lift one foot and hold it a long time.
The wind brings wet mud and grass-root smells.
You stand taller than the trees.
I am only looking; I will not bite.
Is there a leaf in your hand?

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但你不像草。
lines.en: I do not know you, but you are not grass.

lines.zh: 我往前走一步，又退半步。
lines.en: I step forward, then half a step back.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我换个方向。
lines.en: You block my path; I go around.
I look up, neck fully stretched.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我身上，凉。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me, cool.
Crouch down and I can see you properly.

lines.zh: 同伴在叫我，我得回去了。
lines.en: My kin is calling; I should go back.
I have no horns and no fangs.
Your strides are too long for me.
I hop once with the pain.
That blow made my legs weak.
Sixteen health is not much.

lines.zh: 我低低地叫，往草丛里钻。
lines.en: I cry low and push into the grass.
A cut on my hide, and it stings.
I cannot run fast; hiding is all I have.

lines.zh: 同伴在看我，我得站起来。
lines.en: My kin is watching; I must stand.
The wound makes me limp.
I pant, and the grass stirs.
Stop hitting me; I will not fight back.
Leaves? Are those leaves?
I stretch my neck and still cannot reach.
Hold out grass and I will follow.
Put it on the ground and I'll dare to eat it.
This handful will last me a long while.
The leaves in your hand are dripping.

lines.zh: 我闻着清香，就走过来了。
lines.en: I smelled green, so I came over.
Not so high; my neck has limits.

lines.zh: 我吃了你的草，你别摸我。
lines.en: I will eat your grass; do not touch me.
My kin wants some too — half for it.

lines.zh: 我鼻子凑上去，嗅了三下。
lines.en: I bring my nose close and sniff three times.

lines.zh: 这一口咬下去，你的手别动。
lines.en: I am biting now; keep your hand still.
Fruit works too; I am not fussy.

lines.zh: 这味道我从前在平原上找过。
lines.en: I have hunted this taste on plains before.
I eat slowly; do not rush me.
Any more in your hand? Just a little.
Bump me; I will not run.
You are heavier; I give half a step.
Do not step on my tail.
I shift my rear aside and give you the grass.

lines.zh: 我脖子被撞得偏向一边。
lines.en: The knock twists my neck to one side.
You have flattened the grass.
I make a small, low cry.
We are crowding the same clump now.
I am not angry, just confused.
Push me, and I move with the shove.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，轻轻碰它的头。
lines.en: I lower my head to touch its head gently.

lines.zh: 同伴在不远处，我慢慢走过去。
lines.en: My kin is close by; I walk over slowly.

lines.zh: 我发出低低的声音，像咳嗽。
lines.en: I make a low sound, almost a cough.

lines.zh: 尾巴碰尾巴，就算约好了。
lines.en: Tail to tail, and it is settled.
We graze side by side, saying nothing.

lines.zh: 这个季节，草丛里全是同伴。
lines.en: This season the grass is full of kin.

lines.zh: 我绕它走了一圈，再靠近。
lines.en: I circle it once, then come closer.

lines.zh: 我的个头太小，得靠得近些。
lines.en: I am small, so I must come close.
Not so loud; it startles easily.

lines.zh: 我们一起低下头，吃同一丛。
lines.en: We lower our heads to the same clump.

lines.zh: 这片叶子掉了，我叼起来。
lines.en: This leaf fell; I pick it up.
One tender twig — perfect.
A stone? Not eating that.
I test it with my mouth. Soft.
This fruit rolled to my feet.
I gather the leaves into a pile.
This does not smell edible.
I look up to see who dropped it.
A small piece, barely a mouthful.

lines.zh: 我叼着它走了几步，掉了。
lines.en: I carry it a few steps and drop it.

lines.zh: 有东西在草里动，我盯着。
lines.en: Something moves in the grass; I stare.
I do not attack; I only guard.

lines.zh: 那只影子不大，我看看就好。
lines.en: That shadow is small; I will just watch.
As it comes near, I pull my neck in.

lines.zh: 我缩着脖子挡在幼崽前。
lines.en: I shrink my neck and stand in front of the young ones.
I have no weapon; I can only stand.
My courage only reaches as far as not retreating.
If it charges, I will turn and run.

lines.zh: 草叶挡住我，只看清一半。
lines.en: The grass hides it; I only see half.
I give a low warning cry.

lines.zh: 我一直看着它，不敢眨眼。
lines.en: I keep watching it, afraid to blink.
It circles; my head follows.
I nudge the young deeper into the grass.
I retreat slowly, fearing pursuit.
I take one step back, my legs trembling.
It backed off; I still do not relax.

lines.zh: 这平原上没有石头能躲。
lines.en: There is no rock to hide behind on this plain.
Every move it makes, I count.
My kin presses against my side.
One more step and I run.
I have no fangs, only my head to butt with.
This shove barely sways the grass.
I kick once, very lightly.
Back off; I do not want this.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖子，咬着不放。
lines.en: I catch your sleeve and hold.

lines.zh: 我顶了你一下，像顶一棵草。
lines.en: I butt you the way I'd butt a tuft of grass.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过去，像一根鞭子。
lines.en: My tail sweeps like a thin whip.

lines.zh: 我打完就往同伴那边跑。
lines.en: After the blow I run to my kin.

lines.zh: 我不是猎手，我只会护住自己。
lines.en: I am no hunter; I only defend myself.
Do not make me do that twice.

lines.zh: 我从草里站起来，腿还软。
lines.en: I rise from the grass, legs still soft.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的泥沾在我脚上。
lines.en: Triassic mud clings to my feet.

lines.zh: 世界第一次比我的身体大。
lines.en: For the first time the world is bigger than my body.

lines.zh: 我出生时只有老鼠那么大。
lines.en: I was born the size of a mouse.
This clump of grass is taller than me.
I try my first mouthful of leaves.
My kin is already waiting nearby.
The wind scatters my scent.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，看见平原。
lines.en: I lift my head and see the plains.

lines.zh: 妈妈的名字叫鼠龙，我也是。
lines.en: Mother was called Mouse Lizard; so am I.

lines.zh: 我迈出第一步，踩在软土上。
lines.en: I take my first step onto soft soil.
It is quiet here, only grass rustling.
The grass caught fire, and my skin burns too.
I hit the ground with all four legs splayed.

lines.zh: 我四条腿乱蹬，鼻子进水。
lines.en: My four legs thrash as water fills my nose.

lines.zh: 我被掀了个跟头，摔进草里。
lines.en: The blast tumbles me head over heels into the grass.
An arrow sticks in my flank.
A numbness spreads and I cannot stand straight.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连草都咬不动。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I cannot even chew grass.

lines.zh: 雷声太近，我整只都僵了。
lines.en: The thunder was too close; my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 我四腿乱蹬，什么也踩不到。
lines.en: My legs flail against nothing at all.
